items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: But Louis used to play on the street down here. Yes, I heard he did.

ctx.x: Yeah, he died in a sudden. Well if they went to see him that morning, you told him wait a minute he'll be able to go. Well he waited there and he wasn't getting no better so he went on down. When they come back, he was dead. He died that Saturday night. And at the time he died his friend was Louis Armstrong.
